content:
sam: quick PSA — branch cutover today at 12:00 PT. please get changelog entries in by 11:30 so i can do a final sweep. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria: noted, i have a tiny bugfix entry for grpc timeout handling, will push in a sec.
kevin: owners ping: @alex can you confirm the perf bump entry? need a component tag and a one-line impact.
alex: on it. q: our entry shape wants 'impact' then 'why', right? or should i do short bullets?
sam: impact first (1 line), then a short "why". keep it compact. example:
```
- runtime: enable kv-compact-mode — reduces 99th% latency ~5% for long sequences.
  - why: avoids duplicated KV copies when caching; opt-in via CONFIG.
  - author: @alex
```
maria: can we stick to 1-2 bullets max? long paragraphs get collapsed by the release tool.
jen: also add your handle as author at the end (helps traceability).
kevin: quick reminder about branch rules for the cutover: main -> release/1.4 at noon. no direct merges after freeze unless AB approves. if you need a backport, open a PR with label "backport-request" and target release branch.
alex: thanks — submitting PR with entry and label now.
devbot: release-bot: changelog-lint: passed on PR #4321 (:white_check_mark:)
sam: sweet. i'll do the final aggregation at 11:35 and post the assembled notes. if you need extra time or want me to shorten wording, reply here. :thumbsup:
kevin: tiny nit — component tags should be lowercase and single token (runtime, api, docs, infra).
maria: ack, updating to "grpc" as component.
jen: if anyone's doing a docs note, prefix with docs: so the docs team can pick it up.
alex: FYI i'm including a short rollback note in the PR in case we need to revert the perf flag quickly.
sam: perfect. thanks all — this helps the release process stay lean.
jen: also, remember to put the changelog entry in the PR description (top), not just the changelog file. release scraper reads PR body.
kevin: good call. i'll add a checklist comment to the release checklist doc after cutover.
sam: ok closing this thread — i'll ping channel when the assembled notes are live. :white_check_mark:
